entities.summary: Mohamed Nazir bin Abdul Razak is a Malaysian banking executive who served as CEO of CIMB Group from 1999 to 2014 and as chairman from 2014 to 2018. He is the youngest son of Abdul Razak Hussein, Malaysia's Prime Minister from 1970 to 1976, and the brother of Najib Razak, who served as Prime Minister from 2009 to 2018.
